text:
## Common Issues & Resolution  
| Issue | Cause | Resolution |
|-------|-------|-----------|
| Customer requests re-opening | Changed mind | New account opening required (full KYC) |
| Pending standing order on closure date | Timing issue | Execute final SO, then close |
| Dispute received after closure | Customer claim | Reopen investigation, may reverse closure if warranted |
| Customer doesn't collect check | Payment delay | Hold 6 months, escalate to unclaimed money procedures |

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, including handling of pending standing orders, disputes received post-closure, and unclaimed payments. The process addresses common issues such as timing conflicts between standing order execution and closure date, and post-closure dispute investigations.
context: Pending standing order on closure date
Reopen investigation, may reverse closure if warranted

raw_entities.name: Account Re-opening Process
raw_entities.description: Procedure triggered when a customer requests to re-open a previously closed account after changing their mind. Requires full KYC verification as if opening a new account.

raw_entities.name: Unclaimed Money Procedure
raw_entities.description: Procedure for managing payments (such as checks) that customers do not collect within a specified holding period. Involves a 6-month hold followed by escalation to formal unclaimed money procedures.
context: Hold 6 months, escalate to unclaimed money procedures

raw_entities.name: Post-Closure Dispute Investigation
raw_entities.description: Procedure for investigating disputes or claims received after an account has been closed. May result in reversal of the closure if investigation warrants account re-opening.
context: Reopen investigation, may reverse closure if warranted

raw_entities.name: Execute Final Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Discrete step within account closure where any pending standing order scheduled for the closure date is executed before the account is formally closed.
context: Pending standing order on closure date

raw_entities.name: Close Account
raw_entities.description: Final step in the account closure process where the account is formally closed, typically after all pending transactions and standing orders have been resolved.

raw_entities.name: Reopen Investigation
raw_entities.description: Step triggered when a dispute or claim is received after account closure, requiring investigation to determine whether the closure should be reversed.
context: Reopen investigation, may reverse closure if warranted

raw_entities.name: Hold Unclaimed Payment
raw_entities.description: Step where unclaimed payments (such as checks) are held for a 6-month period before escalation to formal unclaimed money procedures.
context: Hold 6 months, escalate to unclaimed money procedures

raw_entities.name: Escalate to Unclaimed Money Procedures
raw_entities.description: Step where unclaimed payments are escalated to formal unclaimed money procedures after the 6-month holding period expires.
context: Hold 6 months, escalate to unclaimed money procedures

raw_entities.name: Perform Full KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: Step required when a customer requests account re-opening after closure, treating the re-opening as a new account opening with complete Know Your Customer verification.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Pending on Closure Date
raw_entities.description: Decision point triggered when a standing order is scheduled to execute on the same date as the requested account closure. The resolution is to execute the standing order first, then proceed with closure.
context: Pending standing order on closure date

raw_entities.name: Dispute Received After Closure
raw_entities.description: Decision point triggered when a customer dispute or claim is received after the account has been closed. Investigation may lead to reversal of the closure if warranted.
context: Reopen investigation, may reverse closure if warranted

raw_entities.name: Customer Re-opening Request
raw_entities.description: Decision point triggered when a customer requests to re-open a previously closed account. The resolution requires full KYC verification as if opening a new account.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: Compliance obligation for full Know Your Customer verification required when a customer requests account re-opening, treating it as a new account opening.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Recurring payment instruction that may be pending on an account closure date, requiring execution before the account is formally closed.
context: Pending standing order on closure date

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: The account subject to closure, re-opening, or dispute investigation procedures outlined in the common issues and resolution table.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The natural person who holds the account and may request re-opening, fail to collect payments, or submit disputes after closure.

raw_entities.name: Unclaimed Check Payment
raw_entities.description: A check payment issued to the customer that remains uncollected, triggering a 6-month hold period followed by escalation to unclaimed money procedures.
context: Hold 6 months, escalate to unclaimed money procedures

properties.name: Standing Order Pending on Closure Date

properties.decision_question: Is a standing order pending execution on the account closure date?
properties.criteria: Standing order scheduled date matches or precedes account closure date
properties.path_yes: Execute final standing order before closing account

properties.decision_question: Is the dispute claim valid and warrants account closure reversal?
properties.criteria: Dispute investigation findings; evidence of customer claim merit
properties.path_yes: Reverse account closure; reopen account or investigate further
properties.path_no: Uphold account closure; deny dispute claim

properties.decision_question: Should the account be reopened or a new account created?
properties.criteria: Customer eligibility; KYC verification status; regulatory requirements
properties.path_yes: Proceed with new account opening; perform full KYC verification
properties.path_no: Deny re-opening request; advise customer of reasons

properties.timing_or_refresh_frequency: Required for new account opening; required for account re-opening after closure
properties.verification_method: Document collection and verification; identity and address confirmation
properties.consequence_of_failure: Account opening denied; customer ineligible to proceed

properties.setup_or_amendment_process: Standing order scheduled and recorded in system
properties.cancellation_process: Final standing order executed before account closure
properties.failure_handling: If standing order fails to execute on closure date, account closure is delayed pending resolution

properties.closure_or_freeze_conditions: Account closed on customer request; may be reopened if dispute investigation warrants reversal

properties.context_role: Account holder requesting closure, re-opening, or disputing post-closure

properties.monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Hold for 6 months; escalate to unclaimed money procedures if not collected
